label: Version 1.3.10
releaseNotes: Simplifies the workflow by removing Generation preset, Preset name, and Recent Runs from the interface.
Keeps the run panel in the normal page layout with focused current status, progress, action, manifest, output, and retry controls.
Adds clear VA, iFAMS, alternating VA + iFAMS, and validated custom-prefix choices for generated Referral Numbers.
Keeps Referral Numbers unique across the batch and removes the selected prefix correctly when building matching TEST ICNs.
Redesigns existing-file handling with explanatory cards, recommends preserving existing files, and identifies when folder contents will be replaced.
Expands business-logic, settings-migration, smoke, and Windows Electron coverage for the simplified workflow.
